body: On-device re-check after #203 and #204 merged (feat/composer-editor-core at 04f07d0), Galaxy Note 10+, 2026-09-25 11:40 to 11:55. Results appended to ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/E2E-REPORT.md; evidence in results/android/verify2/. G1 to G4 are all fixed on the device. The probe build carried a test-only semanticsTap endpoint (not committed) that fires PlatformDispatcher.onSemanticsActionEvent, TalkBack's Flutter entry point.U+000AU+000AWhat the device showed:U+000AU+002D **G2.** Screen-reader taps ticked to-dos on the card and in the viewer. The ticks persisted across a relaunch, the saved source reads - [x], and the card did not open.U+000AU+002D **G3.** The prompt reads the question and the hint once, as a Button, and a screen-reader tap opens the picker.U+000AU+002D **G4.** Viewer and card each expose one labelled clickable node. A screen-reader tap opens the card, and long-press and pill Edit still work.U+000AU+000AThe lingering More formats nodes did not reproduce on either path.U+000AU+000ANewly noted, outside scope:U+000AU+002D The composer's Cancel/Back and Save changes are clickable Views, not Buttons.U+000AU+002D The editor's text area has an unlabelled clickable node.U+000AU+000ATalkBack speech was not run, because enabling it changes a phone setting. Cleanup: the watcher is stopped and the scratch worktrees are removed.
